name: UQ Law LEAD Scholarship
provider: University of Queensland, TC Beirne School of Law
summary: Scholarship for school leavers starting a UQ law degree who have faced educational, social or financial disadvantage.
key: $8,000 per year for up to 5 years.
who: Domestic student who finished senior school in Australia within 2 years of applying, or is finishing it this year.
Commencing the Bachelor of Laws (Honours), including duals, with no prior bachelor-level study.
Can demonstrate educational, social and/or financial disadvantage, and can attend an interview.
how: Put the Bachelor of Laws (Honours) or a law dual as your first or second QTAC preference.
Complete the LEAD Scholarship application form, which also covers the Undergraduate Law Admission Scheme (ULAS).
catches: Applications opened 20 July 2026 and close 1 November 2026.
